description: Plastic sleeves that shrink tight when heated, insulating a bare joint.
how_to_use: Slide a piece onto the wire BEFORE soldering, then push it over the finished joint and warm it with the iron's side or a lighter held at a distance.

plain.what: Little plastic tubes that shrink tight when you heat them — to cover and protect a soldered joint.
plain.how: Slide a piece over the wire before soldering, then move it over the joint and heat it until it hugs the wire.
